topics.title: Entrepreneurship and the entrepreneur
topics.ncert_sections: Introduction; Fig. 6.1, 6.2; From a Dead Mouse to Riches

concepts.learning_objective: Explain entrepreneurship as the process of converting a potential idea into a business venture.
Identify the tasks an entrepreneur performs, such as combining factors of production and taking risks.
Interpret the Jataka tale to show how entrepreneurs spot opportunities and work smart.

topics.title: Entrepreneurial journeys: Lijjat and Oberoi
topics.ncert_sections: From Rooftop to Revolution; The Man who Transformed the Hospitality Industry

concepts.learning_objective: Describe how Lijjat Papad grew as a women's cooperative with equal ownership and shared profits.
Explain how Mohan Singh Oberoi's initiative, risk-taking and management built a hotel chain.

topics.title: Business plan: a road map for the business
topics.ncert_sections: Business Plan - A Road Map for the Business; Fig. 6.6

concepts.learning_objective: Define a business plan as a written blueprint of goals and the steps to achieve them.
Apply the key considerations of a business plan (needs, customers, costs, location, pricing, promotion, risks) to a venture.

topics.title: Functional areas of a business
topics.ncert_sections: Functional Areas of a Business; Fig. 6.9; Management and Operations; Human Resources; Marketing and Sales

concepts.learning_objective: Name the four functional areas of a business and the key focus of each.
Classify business activities into management and operations, human resources, or marketing and sales.
Distinguish between fixed costs and variable costs with examples.
Calculate profit from revenue and expenses using a profit and loss account.

topics.title: Traditional entrepreneurs, startups and the nation
topics.ncert_sections: India's Traditional Entrepreneurial Community; Startups and Their Contribution to the Nation; Fig. 6.13

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the Chettiar community as a traditional entrepreneurial community and its practices.
Describe India's startup ecosystem, unicorns, failure as learning and schemes like Startup India.
Analyse how businesses contribute to society and the economy and to Viksit Bharat 2047.
